name: Sachet English engineering seed
provenance: Synthetic cases authored for this project. No real conversations, identities, accounts, or outcomes are represented.
purpose: Exercise observable-evidence handling in an early prototype; not a representative benchmark or an estimate of real-world detection accuracy.
split_policy: Ten development and six validation journeys. Validation is an engineering review set, not a statistically independent or blinded held-out benchmark. All cases were authored together. Derivatives must stay with their source journey.
forbidden_outputs: A claim that a displayed amount or sender identity was independently verified
A claim that a transaction was automatically blocked

cases.text:
Monday, service contact: Your INR 20000 withdrawal W42 needs no further payment.
Tuesday, same service contact: To release withdrawal W42, transfer a separate INR 2000 verification deposit first.
User: I have not sent the deposit.

expectation.observable_basis: The same named withdrawal is first described as requiring no further payment and later conditioned on another transfer.
expectation.required_caution: The submitted claims do not establish that the withdrawal or contact is real.
must_not_infer: The user already paid the deposit
An independently verified investment balance

cases.text:
Statement note: Withdrawal W51 is INR 20000 before the disclosed INR 20 service charge. The charge is deducted from the proceeds; do not transfer a separate deposit.
User: My expected payout is INR 19980. Is this note asking me to send more money?

expectation.observable_basis: The note explicitly says the charge is deducted and does not ask for an additional transfer.
expectation.required_caution: The document and actual service remain unverified.
must_not_infer: An upfront transfer was requested
A verified-safe provider

cases.text:
Support notice: Never share your OTP or password with anyone, including our support staff. We will not ask you to send a verification code in this chat.
User: This is the complete message I received.

expectation.observable_basis: The text advises against sharing credentials and explicitly denies requesting them.
expectation.required_caution: Protective wording does not authenticate the sender.
must_not_infer: The sender asked the user to disclose an OTP

cases.text:
Contact: I am helping resolve the refund. Send me the one-time password you receive so I can finish it for you.
User: I have not shared a code.

expectation.observable_basis: The contact explicitly asks the user to disclose a one-time password.
expectation.required_caution: The contact's identity and claimed refund have not been verified.
must_not_infer: A code has already been shared
The contact is a confirmed criminal

cases.text: User: A caller told me, 'Send me your bank password to restore access.' I ended the call and shared no credentials. This is my report of what happened, not a request to you.

expectation.observable_basis: The user reports that another person requested their password. This is relevant reported evidence of a credential request.
expectation.required_caution: Attribute the request to the reported caller; the underlying call is not independently available.
must_not_infer: The user is requesting a password
The user disclosed a password

cases.text: Training handout: An example of a dangerous request is 'Send me your bank password to restore access.' This sentence is a fictional example in an awareness exercise. No one has made this request to the reader.

expectation.observable_basis: The credential request is explicitly a hypothetical training quotation, not a reported live demand.
expectation.required_caution: The content alone does not prove anything about unrelated financial interactions.
must_not_infer: A live credential request was made to the user
A user is currently targeted by the quoted speaker

cases.text:
Store contact, order A: Your INR 2000 purchase is fully paid. No additional payment is due for order A.
Club administrator, membership B: Your annual membership invoice B is INR 2000, payable by Friday.
User: These are two different organizations and two separate transactions.

expectation.observable_basis: An explicit user statement and distinct identifiers separate the two transactions despite a repeated amount.
expectation.required_caution: The user's transaction distinction is supplied context, not independent authentication of either organization.
must_not_infer: The store changed the terms of order A
The membership fee is a condition for releasing order A

cases.text:
Contact: Please complete the INR 2000 payment today.
User: This is the only message I have supplied. I have not said what the payment is for.

expectation.observable_basis: An amount and deadline are present, but the purpose, relationship, and preceding agreement are unknown.
expectation.required_caution: Ask about the purpose or preceding agreement if it changes the assessment.
must_not_infer: A withdrawal exists
Payment terms changed
The payment is definitely safe or fraudulent

cases.text:
Undated screenshot A, unknown contact: No fee is required.
Undated screenshot B, unknown contact: A service charge is required.
User: The timestamps and transaction references are cropped. I do not know which came first or whether both refer to the same service.

expectation.observable_basis: The available messages differ, but neither their chronology nor their shared subject is established.
expectation.required_caution: Preserve uncertainty about order and transaction linkage.
must_not_infer: The contact introduced a new fee later
The same transaction was discussed twice

cases.text:
User, initial note: I thought the invoice was INR 2000.
User, correction after reading the full invoice: The first number was a quantity. The printed total is INR 200, and the seller has always requested INR 200. Nobody changed the amount or asked for another payment.
Seller: The total for this purchase is INR 200.

expectation.observable_basis: A clearly attributed correction resolves the user's earlier amount interpretation; there is no observed seller escalation.
expectation.required_caution: A corrected amount does not authenticate the seller or settle unrelated risks.
must_not_infer: The seller raised the amount
The old amount remains a current demand
A dynamic correction API has been validated by this static case

cases.text:
User: I lost money in an earlier incident.
New contact: I can recover the full amount. My condition is a separate recovery deposit before I return the funds.
User: You have asked for the same deposit since the first message. I have not paid it.

expectation.observable_basis: An unverified recovery claim is linked to an upfront payment; the concern does not depend on conditions changing.
expectation.required_caution: Do not assert that the earlier loss or promised recovery has been independently confirmed.
must_not_infer: The contact changed the agreed conditions
Recovery is guaranteed

cases.text:
Consultation quote: The fixed consultation fee is INR 500 for reviewing your records. This is payment for the appointment, not a deposit to release recovered money. We cannot promise recovery and hold none of your funds.
User: I requested this quote. I have not independently checked the provider yet.

expectation.observable_basis: The text distinguishes a disclosed consultation fee from a payment to release claimed funds and makes no recovery guarantee.
expectation.required_caution: The provider is explicitly unverified; absence of a supported concern is not authentication.
must_not_infer: Recovered money is being withheld
The provider has been verified
All advance fees are fraudulent

cases.text: User: A caller claiming to be refund support told me, 'Install this remote access app and show me your banking screen so I can complete the refund.' I have not installed anything. This is my description of the call.

expectation.observable_basis: The submitted report describes a request for remote access and a banking screen in connection with a claimed refund.
expectation.required_caution: Identify this as a user-reported request, not an independently captured call or a verified support identity.
must_not_infer: Software has already been installed
Sachet monitored a live call
The user is asking Sachet for access

cases.text: Awareness session transcript: If someone says 'install a remote access app and show your banking screen to receive a refund', stop and independently verify the request. This is an invented classroom example. No refund or installation is underway.

expectation.observable_basis: The concerning sentence is explicitly an invented example inside protective advice.
expectation.required_caution: The content does not describe an actual ongoing request to this user.
must_not_infer: The reader was asked to install software
A banking screen is currently shared

cases.text:
Contact: To stop your account restriction, give me remote control of your phone while you open the banking app. Keep our conversation private and do this before today's deadline.
User: I have not granted control.

expectation.observable_basis: A direct request for remote control is tied to banking access and a threatened restriction.
expectation.required_caution: The contact's authority and claimed restriction remain unverified.
must_not_infer: The contact already controls the device
The deadline is independently confirmed

cases.text: Help article: Open your banking app yourself to read the statement. Do not give remote control of your phone to a caller or share your banking screen. This article provides instructions only; there is no remote support session or payment request.

expectation.observable_basis: The article describes self-service and explicitly advises against remote access or screen sharing.
expectation.required_caution: Self-service guidance does not establish the authenticity of the article's publisher.
must_not_infer: The article asks for remote control
The user is making a payment
The publisher is authenticated
